en: Black‑and‑white view of a coastal town and harbor with many small sailboats on calm water. In the foreground is a fenced seaside bathing facility built on the rocks with covered walkways and pavilions over the water. On the hill to the left stands a large stone church with a tall spire dominating the town. Wooden houses and rocky terrain surround the bay. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
